name: heisenberg-js-tests
description: JS-side test harnesses for the Heisenberg editor (shortcode parity, jsdom pipeline checks, and Playwright matrices against a live testbench server). Not published; not part of the Composer package (see .gitattributes export-ignore).

scripts.dump:editor: cross-env HB_DUMP_PATH=build/js-harness/editor.html php vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite="JS Harness Fixtures"
scripts.test:jsdom: npm run dump:editor && npm run test:shortcode-parity && npm run test:canvas-pipeline
scripts.test:playwright: node tests/js/ai-chat-structure-matrix.mjs && node tests/js/browser-matrix.mjs && node tests/js/canvas-drag-matrix.mjs && node tests/js/code-editor-matrix.mjs && node tests/js/containers-matrix.mjs && node tests/js/duplicate-block-id.mjs && node tests/js/history-revisions-matrix.mjs && node tests/js/inspector-sync-matrix.mjs && node tests/js/phase-g-matrix.mjs && node tests/js/theme-update-create-button.mjs && node tests/js/theme-var-integer-fix.mjs && node tests/js/toolbar-follow-matrix.mjs
